evaluation_priority: PPG, points, wins, draws, losses and repeatability
goals, xG/NPxG, big chances and chance conversion
xGA, goals conceded and opponent big chances
IP/OOP structure, positions, roles, duties, PI and TI

evidence_rules.historical_versions: Evidence and comparison points, not mandatory templates
evidence_rules.external_meta: Hypothesis source only; not equivalent to this team's season evidence
evidence_rules.build_success: D3 technical verification only; never proof of match effectiveness
evidence_rules.discipline_stats: Fouls, yellow cards and red cards are excluded from tactic-quality evaluation

tool_boundary.fm_ta_role: Generic FMF generation and native-format tooling only
forbidden_changes: Do not modify FM-TA generic exporter or generator rules for this project's policies
Do not modify generic repository build workflows to encode project-specific tactical decisions
Do not impose this project's PPG target on other projects using FM-TA
